name: createClient
description: Creates a Defjs client from option helpers.

name: withEndpoint
description: Sets the valid absolute base URL prepended to relative request paths.

name: withInterceptors
description: Appends interceptors to the client interceptor chain.

name: withQuerySerializer
description: Replaces query encoding for HTTP, SSE, and WebSocket requests.

name: withHTTPHandle
description: Replaces the Fetch-compatible function used for HTTP requests.

name: withSSEHandle
description: Replaces the Fetch-compatible function used to open SSE event streams.

name: withWebSocketHandle
description: Replaces the WebSocket constructor used for socket connections.

name: withCredentials
description: Sets whether HTTP and SSE requests include credentials.

name: withXSRF
description: Enables XSRF cookie-to-header token forwarding for HTTP requests.

name: withSSEReconnect
description: Configures automatic reconnection after an SSE stream fails.

name: withSSEOnInvalidEvent
description: Observes SSE events that have no matching event struct or fail validation.

name: withWebSocketBeforeConnect
description: Runs a hook before the initial WebSocket connect and before every reconnect.

name: withWebSocketProtocols
description: Sets the WebSocket subprotocols offered during the handshake.

name: withWebSocketHeartbeat
description: Enables WebSocket heartbeat messages with optional acknowledgement detection.

name: withWebSocketReconnect
description: Configures automatic reconnection when the socket closes for any reason other than a manual session.close().

name: Client
description: A client returned by createClient holds the resolved ClientConfig and executes HTTP, SSE, and WebSocket commands.

name: ClientOption
description: Function type of the option helpers accepted by createClient.

name: ClientOptions
description: Input-shaped client options, including SSE and WebSocket, that mirror what the option helpers configure.

name: ClientConfig
description: Resolved client configuration after option helpers have been applied.

name: ClientSSEOptions
description: Optional SSE settings applied when creating a client: fetch handle, invalid-event hook, and reconnect policy.

name: ClientSSEConfig
description: Resolved SSE configuration with a required fetch handle.

name: ClientWebSocketOptions
description: Optional WebSocket settings applied when creating a client: constructor, beforeConnect hook, heartbeat, protocols, and reconnect policy.

name: QuerySerializer
description: Serializes an encoded query object into a query string.

name: WebSocketHandle
description: Minimal WebSocket instance surface used by the client transport.

name: WebSocketHandleConstructor
description: Constructor type accepted by withWebSocketHandle.

name: defineRequest
description: Declares a typed HTTP request endpoint.

name: executeHttpCommand
description: Runs an HttpCommand against client config: validate input, send the request, and parse the response.

name: fetchHandler
description: Default HTTP transport: perform httpRequest with fetch and return an HttpResponse.

name: makeResponse
description: Builds an HttpResponse without a network call, for interceptors that short-circuit next and for tests.

name: RequestDefinition
description: Contract for an HTTP endpoint: method, path, optional input, and the structs that decode its bodies.

name: RequestEndpoint
description: Callable endpoint returned by defineRequest.

name: BuilderInput
description: Parsed endpoint input that a request builder receives.

name: HttpRequestShape
description: Request shape an HTTP builder returns: path, query, headers, and body.

name: HttpCommand
description: Opaque executable HTTP command produced by a defineRequest endpoint.

name: HttpExecuteOptions
description: Options passed to client.execute or executeHttpCommand for one HTTP call: progress, abort or timeout, and signal.

name: UseRequestConfig
description: Per-request options for HTTP execution: progress callbacks and cancellation.

name: HttpAwaitResult
description: Await-result tuple for an HTTP call: success is [null, data, response], and failure is [fault, undefined, undefined].

name: RequestSuccessData
description: Decoded success body for the declared output struct, or undefined when none is declared.

name: RequestErrorData
description: Decoded error body for the declared error struct, or undefined when none is declared.

name: HttpRequest
description: Normalized outgoing HTTP request seen by transports, handlers, interceptors, and fetchHandler after the builder runs.

name: HttpMeta
description: Response metadata, available whenever a response reached the client.

name: DecodedResponse
description: Response metadata plus a body that decoded against a declared struct.

name: HttpResponse
description: Wire-shape HTTP response that transports produce and interceptors accept.

name: HttpResponseType
description: Representation used to read an HTTP body before struct validation.

name: HttpProgressEvent
description: Progress snapshot passed to upload and download callbacks.

name: HttpProgressFn
description: Callback invoked as request bytes are uploaded or response bytes are downloaded.

name: MakeResponseOptions
description: Fields accepted by makeResponse when building a synthetic HttpResponse, for example in interceptors.

name: struct
description: Facade object for building protocol-boundary structs and parsing values with its constructors and struct.parse.

name: struct.any
description: Struct that accepts any value except null and undefined, without validation.

name: struct.array
description: Struct that parses an array with one item struct.

name: struct.arrayBuffer
description: Struct that accepts an ArrayBuffer.

name: struct.bigint
description: Struct that accepts a bigint or a bigint string and outputs a bigint.

name: struct.blob
description: Struct that accepts a Blob.

name: struct.boolean
description: Struct that accepts boolean values.

name: struct.date
description: Struct that accepts a Date, timestamp, or date string and outputs a Date.

name: struct.discriminatedUnion
description: Struct that picks one object struct by the value of a tag field.

name: struct.enum
description: Struct that accepts one value from a list of strings or from the values of an object.

name: struct.file
description: Struct that accepts a File.

name: struct.formData
description: Object struct that is encoded as multipart FormData when it is the request body.

name: struct.intersection
description: Struct that requires a value to satisfy every given struct.

name: struct.literal
description: Struct that accepts exactly one boolean, null, number, or string value.

name: struct.null
description: Struct that accepts only null.

name: struct.number
description: Struct that accepts number values except NaN.

name: struct.object
description: Struct that parses a plain object with a fixed set of fields.

name: struct.or
description: Struct that accepts a value matching any one of several structs.

name: struct.parse
description: Parses an unknown value with a struct and returns an error-first tuple.

name: struct.record
description: Struct that parses an object with string keys and one value struct.

name: struct.string
description: Struct that accepts string values.

name: struct.tuple
description: Struct that parses a fixed-length array with one struct per position.

name: struct.unknown
description: Struct that accepts any value except null and undefined, typed as unknown.

name: struct.urlencoded
description: Object struct that is encoded as an URL-encoded form when it is the request body.

name: Infer
description: Infers the parsed output type of a struct, as an alias of the internal output brand.

name: StructInput
description: Type helper that extracts the accepted input type of a struct.

name: AnyStruct
description: Broad struct constraint that accepts any struct, for endpoint and client generics.

name: Struct
description: Public struct contract: input and output types, modifier methods, and the _struct type brand.

name: StructLike
description: Minimal structural brand carried by every struct instance.

name: StructMethods
description: Chainable modifiers available on every Struct instance.

name: ObjectStruct
description: Object-shaped struct type produced by struct.object(shape).

name: ParseResult
description: Error-first tuple returned by struct.parse.

name: ErrorMap
description: Optional callback that rewrites a StructIssue message before it is stored.

name: StructError
description: Error returned by a failed struct parse, aggregating one or more StructIssues and their formatters.

name: StructIssue
description: A single validation failure produced while parsing a struct.

name: FormattedStructError
description: Nested error tree returned by StructError.format().

name: FlattenedStructError
description: Flat field and form error bags returned by StructError.flatten().

name: FaultCode
description: Every failure Defjs reports, as one closed set of codes.

name: FaultClass
description: Extracts the class prefix from a fault code: the segment before its first _.

name: Fault
description: Union of every failure client.execute can return, discriminated by code.

name: FaultOf
description: Any failure returned by client.execute, expressed by its decoded error-body type.

name: HttpStatusFault
description: Fault for a non-2xx response, typed by the declared error struct.

name: HttpStatusFaultOf
description: Non-2xx fault expressed by its decoded body type instead of the struct that produced it.

name: DecodeFault
description: A response arrived but could not be read as declared.

name: PreflightFault
description: A failure that may have happened before any response existed.

name: AnyFault
description: Any fault at all, whatever its decoded error-body type.

name: createHttpStatusFault
description: Builds an HTTP_STATUS fault for a non-2xx response whose body decoded against the declared error struct.

name: createUndecodedHttpStatusFault
description: Builds an HTTP_STATUS fault for a non-2xx response that was never decoded, because the endpoint declared no error struct.

name: createDecodeFault
description: Builds a decode fault for a response that arrived but could not be read as declared.

name: createNetworkFault
description: Builds a NET_* PreflightFault, choosing the code from the shape of cause.

name: createPreflightFault
description: Builds a fault for a failure that may have happened before any response existed.

name: ERR_ABORTED
description: Shared Error sentinel that marks a request as aborted.

name: ERR_TIMEOUT
description: Shared Error sentinel that marks a request as timed out.

name: isAbortCause
description: Whether cause is caller cancellation, across Core copies and platform abort errors.

name: isTimeoutCause
description: Whether cause is a timeout, across Core copies and platform timeout errors.

name: createHttpInterceptor
description: Wraps an InterceptorFn as a tagged HttpInterceptor.

name: createSSEInterceptor
description: Wraps an SSEInterceptorFn as a tagged SSEInterceptor.

name: createWebSocketInterceptor
description: Wraps a WebSocketInterceptorFn as a tagged WebSocketInterceptor.

name: basicAuthHttpInterceptor
description: HTTP interceptor that sets an Authorization: Basic … header from credentials.

name: basicAuthSSEInterceptor
description: SSE interceptor that sets an Authorization: Basic … header from credentials.

name: Interceptor
description: Any tagged interceptor accepted by client interceptor options.

name: InterceptorFn
description: HTTP interceptor function: may inspect or modify the request, then call next.

name: HttpInterceptor
description: Tagged HTTP interceptor accepted by client interceptor options.

name: HttpInterceptorNext
description: Continuation that runs the rest of the HTTP interceptor chain, or the handler.

name: SSEInterceptor
description: Tagged SSE interceptor for client option lists, accepted by withInterceptors.

name: SSEInterceptorFn
description: SSE interceptor function: may inspect, modify, or replace the request, then call next.

name: SSEHandler
description: Terminal next function an SSE interceptor receives; it opens an event stream for the request.

name: WebSocketInterceptor
description: Tagged WebSocket interceptor for client option lists, accepted by withInterceptors.

name: WebSocketInterceptorFn
description: WebSocket interceptor function: may inspect, modify, or replace the request, then call next.

name: WebSocketHandler
description: Terminal next function a WebSocket interceptor receives; it opens a session for the request.

name: WebSocketSessionLike
description: Minimal WebSocket session surface that interceptors see.

name: BasicAuthInterceptorOptions
description: Options for basic-auth interceptors, including a custom credential encoder.

name: defineEventStream
description: Declare a typed Server-Sent Events endpoint.

name: executeEventStreamCommand
description: Open an SSE command against the given client config.

name: EventStreamDefinition
description: Contract that describes an SSE endpoint for defineEventStream.

name: EventStreamEndpoint
description: Callable endpoint returned by defineEventStream.

name: EventStreamRequestShape
description: Request shape an SSE builder returns: the same fields as HttpRequestShape for method M and path P.

name: EventStreamCommand
description: Opaque executable SSE command produced by an EventStreamEndpoint.

name: EventStreamExecuteOptions
description: Per-call options for opening an SSE stream: abort or timeout, plus an optional signal.

name: StreamAwaitResult
description: Await-result tuple from opening an SSE stream via client.execute.

name: EventStreamHandle
description: Open SSE stream: iterate events, read open metadata, and close early.

name: EventStreamOpenInfo
description: Metadata available once an SSE response has opened.

name: EventStreamCloseInfo
description: How an SSE stream ended: clean EOF, abort, or an error carrying its fault code.

name: EventStructs
description: Map from SSE event names to the structs that decode their data.

name: EventStreamData
description: Union of parsed SSE events inferred from an EventStructs map.

name: defineWebSocket
description: Declare a typed WebSocket endpoint.

name: executeWebSocketCommand
description: Open a WebSocket command against the given client config.

name: WebSocketDefinition
description: Contract object passed to defineWebSocket.

name: WebSocketEndpoint
description: Callable returned by defineWebSocket.

name: WebSocketRequestShape
description: Request shape the builder of a WebSocketDefinition may return, where P is the endpoint path.

name: WebSocketCommand
description: Executable command created by calling a WebSocketEndpoint.

name: WebSocketExecuteOptions
description: Per-call options for executing a WebSocket command.

name: UseWebSocketConfig
description: WebSocket execute options without signal.

name: SocketAwaitResult
description: Await-result tuple from opening a WebSocket via client.execute.

name: WebSocketSession
description: Typed WebSocket session: send and receive messages, observe state, and close.

name: WebSocketState
description: Lifecycle state of a managed WebSocket session.

name: WebSocketConnectionInfo
description: Connection metadata for the current WebSocket generation.

name: WebSocketCloseInfo
description: Logical terminal outcome of a WebSocket session.

name: ManualSocketCloseReason
description: Close code and reason recorded when a session is closed with session.close.

name: WebSocketHeartbeatConfig
description: Heartbeat ping and acknowledgement settings for a live WebSocket session.

name: WebSocketIncomingData
description: Decoded type of a received WebSocket message.

name: WebSocketOutgoingData
description: Type accepted by WebSocket session send.

name: SocketLifecycleOutcome
description: The outcome of a single connect attempt, not the final result of the session.

name: createClientPlugin
description: Create a Vue plugin that provides an existing Defjs client via HTTP_CLIENT.

name: injectClient
description: Vue composable that injects the Defjs client for a key, defaulting to HTTP_CLIENT.

name: HTTP_CLIENT
description: Vue injection key for the Defjs Client provided by createClientPlugin.

name: ClientProvider
description: Provide a Defjs client to React descendants via context.

name: useClient
description: React Hook that returns an explicit Defjs client or the nearest ClientProvider.

name: ClientProviderProps
description: Props of ClientProvider: the required client and optional children.

name: withOpenTelemetryServer
description: Client option that installs outbound OpenTelemetry interceptors for HTTP, SSE, and WebSocket.

name: OpenTelemetryServerOptions
description: Options for withOpenTelemetryServer: tracer, meter, logger, propagator, and per-transport settings.

name: OpenTelemetryServerTransportOptions
description: Shared per-transport OpenTelemetry client options: whether the transport is enabled and its span hooks, generic over the response type.

name: OpenTelemetryServerHttpOptions
description: Options for the HTTP transport — the shared options with an HttpResponse in responseHook.

name: OpenTelemetryServerSSEOptions
description: Options for the SSE transport — the shared options with the stream handle in responseHook.

name: OpenTelemetryServerWebSocketOptions
description: Options for the WebSocket transport — the shared options plus queryPropagation.

name: FetchHandle
description: Fetch-compatible function used as an HTTP or SSE handle.

name: withHeaders
description: Sets static default headers for HTTP and SSE requests built by this client.

name: withTimeout
description: Sets the default timeout, in milliseconds, for HTTP execute only.

name: DecodeFaultCode
description: Codes whose fault carries response metadata but no body.

name: PreflightFaultCode
description: Codes whose fault may never have reached a response.

name: createResolvedRequestUrl
description: Resolves a relative definition path under the base endpoint's origin and directory into a URL.

name: EventStreamFaultCode
description: Fault codes an event stream can end with, drawn from the one shared FaultCode namespace.

name: STRUCT
description: Type-only export of the internal enumerable tag key on objects produced while parsing endpoint input, used by the outbound encoder.
